Upon arrival at the entry gate to the Alhambra complex, we were introduced to our certified guide.  The six of us from the cruise ship were joined by 6 others.  We were given quiet box sets and moved through the gardens and palaces in an unrushed manner.  We had time to use the restrooms before the tour began, and  between the garden and palace visits.  We also visited a specialty shop and watched the craftsman create a complex inlaid wood piece.  

The driver was only a drive

29379P5.author: Jessie_G

29379P5.author: Debra_B

29379P5.author: Shelly_S

The day is very long as it takes at least 3 hours by bus each way, but it's completely worthy. The St Michael's cave and the monkeys are top attractions and shouldn't be missed. It would have been nice to have an extra half an hour in Gibraltar main street but we are overall happy and we recommend it.
105902P3.author: Roberto_G

105902P3.title: Awesome Gibraltar!!!
105902P3.text: Perfect tour of the Gibraltar, visited Rock, Cave, and other surrounding places! The tour also permitted plenty of time for visiting & eating in the shopping area! Very informative & well organized! Thank you to the bus driver, the guide, and the mini bus driver/guide!!!
105902P3.author: Miki_P

105902P3.title: Discovery tour to Gibraltar
105902P3.text: Great excursion to Gibraltar. Everything was organized great and worked out perfectly.
105902P3.author: X3078GAthomase

105902P3.title: Beautiful views.
105902P3.text: Gibralter was quite a tourist trap.  But, we enjoyed the trip up the mountain (even though a bit scary!).  The monkeys were fun, St. Michael's Cave was very cool.  The views were incredible.  Just avoid the shopping in town!
105902P3.author: 769lanep

105902P3.title: We had a fantastic time...
105902P3.text: We had a fantastic time on the Gibraltar Classic Rock Tour from Costa del Sol! It was a wonderful way to see Gibraltar and experience the beautiful scenery and unique history of the area. Our tour was well organized, and everything went smoothly from start to finish. We really enjoyed the experience and would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting the Costa del Sol!
105902P3.author: Jenn_B

105902P3.title: A very fun and 100% recommended experience!
105902P3.text:
I took this trip to Gibraltar with my teenage daughter and it was a super interesting experience; she came back enthusiastic. In my opinion, the time they give you is more than enough to see the main points of interest: the cave, the monkeys, the main street, and the port can be seen without a problem. The only thing I wanted to see closer was the airport with the road that crosses it, since we didn't have enough time.

An unforgettable anecdote: the guide warned us not to give candy to the monkeys. My daughter thought they were shy and would ask for food, but we were left speechless when we s
105902P3.author: A9352XRnatalias

105902P3.title: Highly recommended. Look for Tania
105902P3.text: The tour operator was great, send messages a day before to confirm location and time for pickup. They were a little behind schedule but communication was helpful and removed any concerns.
105902P3.author: shahes2015

105902P3.title: Surprising and unexpected experience
105902P3.text: Melina and Ana, two professionals, each in her own work, highlighting the passion and love for her work of the guide, who always offers more than 200 percent on the excursions she leads
105902P3.author: tinog816

105902P3.title: Don't miss it!
105902P3.text:
This tour was very well organised. We were picked up on time (7.15 in Malaga) and we were back in Malaga by 6pm.
Our guide, Kovi (?) was excellent - patient, attentive, good English and gave very clear instructions.
We had a couple of free hours in the centre of Gibraltar before transferring to a minibus for a tour of the rock. This took us to Europa Point and St Michael's Cave. Unfortunately, the guide on our minibus was not in Kovi's league. He spoke too quickly and did not give clear instructions.
Despite this it was a wonderful day out.
Don't miss it!
105902P3.author: Howard_W

63610P3.title: Magnificent Malaga on Segway
63610P3.text:
This was the first time on a Segway, and our guide Fidor made sure we were comfortable and safe. Really showed us all the highlights of Malaga. It was very informative and explained both the history and how the language of the different cultures impacted history. 

Loved it and will definitely look to do Segway tours elsewhere
63610P3.author: Sheryl_U

63610P3.title: Segway tour in Malaga with Fiodor
63610P3.text:
My wife (Kris) and I took the private 2+ hours Segway tour lead by our guide, Fiodor. We had the most wonderful time navigating thru our monuments route on the Segways. 
The meeting start/end point was conveniently located close to the cruise ship shuttle stop, about a 5 minute stroll. We’d never ridden on a Segway before, but our apprehensions were put to rest after just a few minutes of test driving and feeling at ease on the Segways with the starts, stops, and turns. 
While on the tour, going up the hill to the castle was a breeze, and Kris and I were so grateful and elated that we didn’t h
63610P3.author: EddieSetGo

63610P3.title: Segway is a great way!
63610P3.text: Aymen was exceptional, great tour guide and Segway teacher! He was funny, Informative and patient. We wanted more time around Malaga with him. Highly recommended way to see around the city, and if you get Aymen that’s a bonus!!
63610P3.author: jaybd01

63610P3.title: Fabulous, fun  and informative tour.
63610P3.text: Our guide Fiodor was excellent. He ran through how to use the segways and health and safety before we set off. We had a wonderful two hour tour with him. I learnt more about Spain in the two hours on this tour than I've learnt in all my 58 years. I would highly recommend the tour without hesitation. Fabulous!
63610P3.author: Safari54609761062

63610P3.title: Recommend!
63610P3.text: Great tour, far better than climbing the hills to the top!
63610P3.author: 577jefferyg

63610P3.title: From Missed Slot to Private Tour – Amazing Experience!
63610P3.text: I missed my original 10:00 AM booking, but customer service "Fiodor"was gracious enough to reschedule me for 1:30 PM. To my pleasant surprise, it ended up being a private tour with Aymen! We had a blast together, and riding the Segway was such a great experience. Highly recommend!
63610P3.author: M6609IDaymans

63610P3.title: Great Family Outing
63610P3.text: A great experience with Malaga City Tour and Fidor.   I really appreciate the care and attention to the groups safety and making it an informative outing.  We learned alot about each location we visited.  Thank you for making everything so easy. I’d happily recommend Fidor to others!
63610P3.author: ci2v

63610P3.title: Fun tour
63610P3.text: We really enjoyed everything about this tour.  Our guide (Aymen) was fun, knowledgeable and took us to some great sites.  We felt safe, and really had fun.
63610P3.author: lancet2020

63610P3.title: Great time on our Segway tour of Malaga!
63610P3.text: First timers on segways and it was easy to learn how to operate them and our guide was excellent! Aymen, our tour guide was exceptional!!
63610P3.author: David_B

63610P3.title: Highly recommended!
63610P3.text: Highly recommended 😀👏👏 For a nice way to experience Malaga and not least the height (the castle) over the city. And the guide (Aymen) was a pleasure to be shown around by; Both knowledgeable and pleasant.
63610P3.author: Bernt7

174938P26.title: The best way to see the highlights of Malaga
174938P26.text:
Adriano was a great guide. Very knowledgable and accommodating.
The best way to see the sights in a TukTuk.
We highly recommend.
174938P26.author: Marianne_D

174938P26.title: Excellent
174938P26.text: Great tour! Our driver/guide, Adriano, was fantastic! He explained everything & stopped when we wanted to see something. Adriano was extremely friendly! Loved this Tuk Tuk experience!
174938P26.author: Kelli_B

174938P26.title: Cozy with friends
174938P26.text: Nice guide. Seen many times. Been to places I didn't know while I was in Malaga for 2 weeks.
174938P26.author: corried674

174938P26.title: Malaga
174938P26.text: We saw an overview of Malaga and thoroughly enjoyed our tour guide Carlos.  He was extremely. Knowledgeable.  The sound system was a little difficult in the back seat
174938P26.author: elaineashenfelter

174938P26.title: Excellent Tour
174938P26.text: I highly recommend this tour. Alberto was incredibly knowledgeable. Can’t say enough about it. We reserved a two-hour tour. It was worth it.  The company was proactive and very responsive to my questions. They gave great detailed information so that finding the pick-up spot was fairly easy.
174938P26.author: Expedition672892

174938P26.title: Fun and factual
174938P26.text: Sandra was a great guide. Perfect way to orientate ourselves on first trip to Malaga. Good mix of historical info and fun facts about the city. Informal and fun with plenty of time to ask questions making it more personal.  Recommend highly
174938P26.author: fanchocotastic

174938P26.title: The perfect Malaga experience with Angel and his rum tuk
174938P26.text: A brilliant introduction to the city. Angel really knew his history, had great English and made sure we had a good time. Great guidance for what to add in later in our stay, even covering the historic centre where the Tul Tul cannot go.
174938P26.author: DAWINIAN

174938P26.title: In one hour you learn so much about Malaga
174938P26.text:
Very impressed by the communication leading up to the trip on the Tuk Tuk.
Our guide, Aurelio was excellent, he was not only knowledgeable but added a sense of humour to our trip.
You learn so much more on a personalised trip.
174938P26.author: Nevisdog

174938P26.title: A fun way to discover Málaga.
174938P26.text: Our tuk-tuk tour was definitely a real highlight during our city trip to Málaga! We had a very friendly guide who even gave us more interesting information than we had expected beforehand. It is an incredibly pleasant way to discover the city. Furthermore, it was a great luxury to be able to visit the higher parts of the city effortlessly in this way.
174938P26.author: GlennM2940

174938P26.title: Excellent Tour
174938P26.text: Excellent tour with Alberto. Interesting & Informative & fun. Highly recommend as an introduction to beaMalaga
174938P26.author: joanneaX8220OH

5568965P1.title: Awesome!
5568965P1.text: Really nice time! Saw dolphins real close. Awesome boat trip! The katamaran was very comfortable. Can really recommend this trip!
5568965P1.author: Elin_J

5568965P1.title: Great morning out on the sea!
5568965P1.text: Cat is easy to find, the two guys running the trip are lovely, got drinks and crisps provided. We weren’t sure we’d see dolphins but lo and behold we found them. The trip was fun even without. Sitting on the front of the boat in the sun, blankets provided if it’s chilly, views of the coastline. Would 💯 go again.
5568965P1.author: Georgina_W

5568965P1.title: Amazing
5568965P1.text: Had a super nice evening on the boat. We saw a beautiful sunset! I would definitely recommend the two-hour hike. We got a drink of your choice and then some chips in a bowl at the end. It was cold and very windy and they came with a blanket. Super friendly and definitely recommended.
5568965P1.author: b0utheyna0

5568965P1.title: Well worht the extra...
5568965P1.text: Well worht the extra money instead of been crammed onto one of the other boats. Plenty of space to sit or sunbath on the boats nets
5568965P1.author: Luke_S

5568965P1.title: Fabulous trip
5568965P1.text:
Absolutely fabulous trip, we arrived half an hour early and boarded and left soon after. We were 12 ladies together and had the boat to ourselves. The crew were brilliant and helped a few ladies that were apprehensive to the front of the boat. We followed a pod of dolphins so didn't have time to go in the he water, but too wonderful to miss. 
Would highly recommend this trip, great value for money and a wonderful experience from start to finish.
5568965P1.author: 573bevh

5568965P1.title: Reasonably priced for an...
5568965P1.text: Reasonably priced for an unforgettable experience. The hosts were very friendly and attentive. Didn’t see any dolphins but it didn’t take away from the enjoyment of being out at sea. Although it mentions snorkels and paddy boats provided, we only booked a 2 hour trip and understand that they likely get them out for longer bookings, which makes sense. All in 10/10.
5568965P1.author: Rebecca_N

5568965P1.title: Wonderful catamaran ride
5568965P1.text:
Wonderful and extraordinary experience, discovering dolphins in their natural environment is just incredible. 
For the bravest, it is possible to swim in the open sea.
5568965P1.author: Celine_D

5568965P1.title: Sun, sea, and even dolphins… what more could you ask for?!!
5568965P1.text: Perfect organization and very, very nice staff. And then the sun, the sea, the beautiful dolphins, and friends… I also think that twelve people is the perfect number… I recommend it.
5568965P1.author: Francesca_P

5568965P1.title: A beautiful experience...
5568965P1.text: A beautiful experience, few people, super relaxing, kind and helpful onboard staff!!
5568965P1.author: Maria_X

5568965P1.title: Great experience
5568965P1.text: This was a great experience. The ride, the views and swimming was worth it. Very friendly crew. We will definitely recommend.
5568965P1.author: UlisesD_R

460190P1.title: Spanish Sabores
460190P1.text: Great opportunity to learn how to make paella.  We were taught the traditional method using ingredients we don’t see at a restaurant.  We also made a soup and salad we had never tried before. They were so delicious
460190P1.author: Elsa_G

460190P1.title: Exciting paella cooking class
460190P1.text:
The paella cooking class was very exciting, the almond soup and paella were very delicious 😋, let's see if we can manage that at home too. 
I personally wouldn't cook the special potato salad again, nor the dessert, but it was great to try something new.
Diego did his job very well, and we were also able to ask many questions about the Spanish way of cooking.
460190P1.author: amsljSchweiz

460190P1.title: PERFECT.
460190P1.text:
A completely perfect day. Delicious food that gave inspiration and the desire to try serving these dishes to friends and family. Nice to be with couples from Germany, the USA, and England. Diego was absolutely fantastic. Very present and passionate. Full of humor and understandable English.  We have been to a cooking course in Bologna before through GetYourGuide and we only have positive experiences and words for it. So DON'T MISS OUT ON THESE EXPERIENCES no matter where you go. 
Thanks for GetYourGuide ♥️🇩🇰
460190P1.author: Camper08616970782

460190P1.title: Wonderful experience
460190P1.text: A wonderful lesson on paella including the “science” behind. Diego was a great instructor with a wonderful sense of humor. Paula was also great looking after our well-being. We also made a cold soup and typical local salad.
460190P1.author: rolfpvp

460190P1.title: Wonderful Paella class
460190P1.text: Fun class. Clean facility. Diego was a Great instructor. While the paella was deeply delicious, the soup and salad were also uniquely delightful.
460190P1.author: Mavis_N

460190P1.title: Fabulous!
460190P1.text:
Fabulous experience! Expert coaching and entertaining. Laura is a great teacher and cook and I even signed up for her Tapas class the next day!
Parking is a drag so get early or take public transport!
460190P1.author: M5534HRrajp

460190P1.title: Couldn't be better
460190P1.text:
10/10 experience! Laura is super friendly and makes the workshop very enjoyable; plus, she cooks incredibly well. 
It is also located in a central area. I would do it again.
460190P1.author: Navigator60865263567

460190P1.title: A great experience.
460190P1.text: A wonderful experience! We were a large group of friends, Laura was super attentive. There were some food restrictions and she made sure that we were all comfortable. I will definitely do it again!
460190P1.author: H9304OGmartad

460190P1.title: A different way to celebrate a bachelorette party.
460190P1.text: We were there at the end of September for a bachelorette party. Laura is charming and super professional; she adapted the menu to everyone's tastes and took into account the group's different food intolerances. The best part is the possibility of participating in the cooking; she explains how to do it, and the experience of being able to cook with your friends is unrepeatable. Thank you very much for everything!
460190P1.author: AngelaCO93

460190P1.title: How to make and eat Paella the right way
460190P1.text: It was a great experience how to make paella, ajo blanco and sangria. The eating and drinking was even more fun. The guidance of Diego was good and there was enough time to ask questions and talk about food.
460190P1.author: EdwinNieuwpoort

450081P1.title: Wonderful tour
450081P1.text:
Ali took my father and around for a full
Day private tour. He was fantastic.  Very kind and funny and so informative. We felt we really got to see a good part of Tangier and really enjoyed it. He answered all our questions and did whatever he could to make us happy. We felt very safe at all times. He had us eat 2 great meals Was very well organized from the pickup at the hotel and the return pickup at the ferry to bring us back to our hotel in Malaga. Highly recommend. Best private tour we have had.
450081P1.author: Jennifer_W

450081P1.title: Amazing
450081P1.text: He was very knowledgeable about this city. Very welcoming and made us feel very safe and taken care of. He made Morocco come alive. We will always remember this experience because of him!
450081P1.author: Michael_H

450081P1.title: Excellent tour.
450081P1.text: Everything was great. All was very well thought out: transportation, points of interest, camel ride. Tour guide  was also excellent. Everyone wanted us to have best experience and they succeeded. We highly recommend this tour.
450081P1.author: Sergei_O

450081P1.title: Great experience; professional tour team
450081P1.text:
This was a once in a lifetime experience! After this tour it made us want to go to Tangier again for a much longer stay!

The team picked us up near our Airbnb right on time for a roughly 2 hour drive to Tarifa. I’m not used to the Spanish style of driving the freeway so at times it was a bit hair raising but we arrived safely and on time to catch our ferry. The driver filled out all the paperwork and told us he’ll be back to get us after our return ferry.

Upon arriving on Tangier and clearing customs we were greeted by Hazma. Hazma was great.
Very knowledgeable and pleasant. He made sure we
450081P1.author: Gy0S

450081P1.title: Great time in Tanger
450081P1.text:
Hamza and our Driver did a wonderful job! Hamza was funny, entertaining, personable, informational and made our day very fun and memorable. 
Visitors should know that there are many stairs leading down to the beach for the camel ride so keep that in mind when booking this trip. The camel ride was great!
It really meant a lot to Ali (Hamza’s Brother) and Hamza that we had a great time which, we appreciated.
The restaurants that we ate at for lunch and breakfast were delicious and plentiful.  
The restaurant for  breakfast was in a lovely setting and the restaurant for lunch had live music.
All
450081P1.author: Victoria_M

450081P1.title: Our guide was excellent,...
450081P1.text: Our guide was excellent, Hassan, aka Coca Cola, was knowledgeable, funny, friendly and just great.   The lunch was excellent.
450081P1.author: Ev_G

450081P1.title: Great Day
450081P1.text: Excellent tour of Tangier. Our guide Abdull was born and raised in Tangier, so he knew absolutely everyone and all the sights to see from a personal viewpoint. Had 2 fantastic meals and offered a chance to do some shopping. Ferry connections and drive from Málaga was flawless. Would recommend this tour to anyone looking for close up view of Tangier. Ask for Abdull as your guide.
450081P1.author: Charles_K

450081P1.title: One day private tour of tangiers city..Chafik was great. Personable. Helpful. Knowledgeable. English very good.
450081P1.text: One day private tour of tangiers
450081P1.author: Larry S

450081P1.title: Safe and tailored tour of Tangier
450081P1.text: Communication began soon after we booked. Ali asked about our preferences for activities and foods and wanted to find out what we especially were interested in doing and seeing. He arranged for a driver to pick us up/drop us off at our resort. He arranged our ferry trip to/from Tangier. Our guide, Abdul, met us at the ferry where there were a lot of locals offering visitors a tour. He drove us to the must-see spots and avoided what we weren’t interested in (shopping). He tailored our tour to exactly what we wanted to do. He made us feel safe and shooed away street vendors. He was entertaining
450081P1.author: Paige_R

450081P1.title: Amazing taste of Tangier!
450081P1.text: This is a truly amazing and memorable experience. We saw so much with great fun. The food was absolutely delicious!! Ali took great care of us down to every detail.  Worth every penny for the wonderfully unique experience. I would do it again and take more friends along!
450081P1.author: Gloria_Z

113310P45.title: Interesting Tour
113310P45.text: Not only are the two sites of interest but the bus travel.through the country side was also informative.
113310P45.author: Larry_S

113310P45.title: Must do day trip from Malaga
113310P45.text: Mercedes did a great job showing us Ronda and Sentenil. If you have a chance for one day trip out of Malaga, do this one
113310P45.author: Marjorie_B

113310P45.title: The guide at Ronda ...
113310P45.text: The guide at Ronda  (Valme) excellent. We arrived early so there were no other groups, the best way to see the city and the famous bridge. I would prefer a bit more free time in Ronda so we could enjoy our lunch instaed or rushing or visit the archeological museum. One hour in Sentenil was just right. But all in all it was a great day and I would recommend this day trip.
113310P45.author: Vlatka_M

113310P45.title: Ronda and Setenil de las Bodegas Day Tour
113310P45.text: This one day tour to Ronda and Setenil de las Bodegas was an enjoyable experience. Our tour guide Marcedes was very knowledgeable on the history and cultural activities of both sites.  The scenic views of both the historic architectural structures and surrounding landscape were amazing!  A scheduled break in the tour provided an opportunity to sample some of the tasty tapas that just naturally went well with a cold cerveza and an excellent Mojito!
113310P45.author: Debra_B

113310P45.title: Breathtaking towns!
113310P45.text: Ronda is a must see town.  It is breathtaking! Our town guide, Antonio, was extraordinary. He is a local and knew so much. His tour gave us a great overview of this beautiful city.  We had plenty of time to explore on our own. J.J., our head guide, was so helpful and friendly. He gave great recommendations and took us on a short, good, tour to Setenil.  This town as well is fantastic. It was a great day. I’m so glad I took this tour.
113310P45.author: Nancy_Z

113310P45.title: First class experience
113310P45.text:
Excellent experience first class coach (Chris) and local guild (Valmae). 
We really enjoyed the experience. Lots of walking involved.
113310P45.author: BoardingPass625650

113310P45.title: Yes!
113310P45.text: Easy pick up and great communication with the tour group. Comfortable bus ride to the two cities. Would definitely recommend if you are pressed on time when visiting Malaga.
113310P45.author: Mio_F

113310P45.title: Well organized tour with...
113310P45.text: Well organized tour with clear instructions. A round of applause for driver and both guides. I enjoyed it a lot.
113310P45.author: Renata_M

113310P45.title: Ronda trip from Malaga
113310P45.text: A taster to what you can see in Ronda and the unique place of Sentile des Bogeda. The Hotel overlooking the bullring rooftop bar is a brilliant place to admire the view and top up on refreshments.
113310P45.author: Elaine_M

117866P257.title: Jam packed 2 hour tour
117866P257.text: Michelle was an absolute wealth of knowledge and energy!  We learned more about the history of Malaga on our 2 short hours with her than our prior tour that was all day! Michelle was very accommodating to where we wanted to go and provided insights the entire time.  The old market was a highlight that I would recommend seeing.  Can’t think of a better way to spend a few hours in beautiful Malaga.
117866P257.author: denisedT8958LC

117866P257.title: Tour of Malaga and airport drop off!!
117866P257.text: We had a wonderful tour of the city highlights with Michelle. She was full of knowledge and even sent me audio presentations of the places we visited so we could learn about the areas as we walked around them. I would highly recommend this company and Michelle as your tour guide if you are in Malaga , Spain. She spoke both English and Spanish flawlessly !
117866P257.author: A9334CQjanef

117866P257.title: Costa del Sol - knowledgeable guide and interesting outing
117866P257.text: Our tour with Jacob was definitely a highlight of our Malaga visit.  We had hoped to get a feeling for the Costa del Sol and we were not disappointed!  We visited the Castillo Colomares, Estupa de la illuminacion, Puerto Banus, and the old Marbella city centre.  We learned about other aspects of Malaga culture and history on our drive.  We would definitely recommend this tour and Jacob in particular as your guide!
117866P257.author: Nancy_G

117866P257.title: Excellent
117866P257.text: Michelle was extremely knowledgeable, personable, accommodating, friendly and respectful of what we wanted to see. Her historical presentation was like listening to a friend rather than hearing a canned script. We thoroughly enjoyed the afternoon with Michelle.
117866P257.author: Marjorie_B

117866P257.title: Great Tour of Malaga.
117866P257.text: We had a wonderful tour with Michelle. You can immediately tell how much she loves her community and how much pride she takes in it. She didn’t just show us sites, she shared personal stories, history and a real connection to the people who live here. It made the whole experience feel authentic and heartfelt. Highly recommend.  Way better than a bus tour.
117866P257.author: 784denag

117866P257.title: Excellent tour with Michelle!
117866P257.text: Excellent tour with Michelle! She's an excellent guide. Very organized. A great driver. Considerate. Knowledgeable. And a great communicator about pickup arrangements. This was a very good experience!
117866P257.author: Tracy_P

117866P257.title: Perfect airport transport!
117866P257.text: It was so easy to be met at the ship, put your luggage in the trunk,  be driven on a short tour, and then dropped off at the airport for your flight later in the day!
117866P257.author: Sue_K

301762P7.title: Great
301762P7.text: Two very beautiful villages, very different from each other, but both equally beautiful. Good wine tasting
301762P7.author: Elisabeth_V

301762P7.title: One day trip to Ronda and Setenil with aFlores
301762P7.text: We made this trip to go out of Málaga and experience the atmosphere of Andalusia. The trip was very well organised, the bus was clean and comfortable. Flores, our guide was really passionate and knowledgeable about the cities and the area. We had a very pleasant time, food and drinks.
301762P7.author: Magdalena_G

301762P7.title: It is well organized and...
301762P7.text: It is well organized and takes you to 2 beautiful places.  If you like to know the history of the place you are visiting I highly recommend the 2 hour guided portion and then 2 hour free time in Ronda.  Our guide was so knowledgeable and friendly!
301762P7.author: Reagan_C

301762P7.title: Excellent guide - Ramón...
301762P7.text: Excellent guide - Ramón - he explained a lot of the history, geography, and economy to us with great patience and good humor.
301762P7.author: Marie_V

301762P7.title: Wonderful and Unforgettable Experience!
301762P7.text: We had a fantastic excursion to Ronda and Setenil de las Bodegas! Everything was perfectly organized, from the itinerary to the timing of each stop. Our guide was knowledgeable, friendly, and engaging, making the experience even more enjoyable. Both destinations were AMAZING, and the wine tasting was a special highlight that added a lovely local touch. An unforgettable experience from beginning to end. Highly recommended!
301762P7.author: arletysp

301762P7.title: Extraordinary!!! 100%
301762P7.text: It was an extraordinary day, everything worked out great and we saw and experienced a lot. The explanations from the nice lady (Ana) were more than helpful. A very nice personality. It is definitely worth it and the price, super cheap!!! Anytime again!
301762P7.author: Christa_M

301762P7.title: Great tour and excellent value
301762P7.text:

We hadn’t changed money yet and that was a little stressful for us. Fortunately our guide helped us out. 😀

We opted for the guided tour (recommended). Daphne our guide was outstanding. Very knowledgeable, engaging and helpful.  After the tour we had a great lunch and made our way back to the bus for the ride to Sentenil.  

All in all a very fun filled and exhausting day. Worth every bit of time

The castle is not very big; in about 10 minutes you can see practically everything. The visit focuses almost exclusively on the exterior, with only one interior room that houses some artifacts, so do not expect a castle to explore.

The price, however, is really honest, only $3.50, so out of curiosity it is worth stopping by. Inside there is also a small bar where you can stop to have something cool

Thank you it made our trip to Malaga more special

I believe that if the visitor were welcomed by one of the saleswomen at this moment and the trial included at least four bread rings, it would be more appropriate, welcoming, and pleasant; even if they charged a little more for the entrance. They lost many points in this stage of the visit.

100438P17.text: Excellent experience! We really learned a lot. The mini picnic was also cute. I recommend it to everyone, they speak several languages.
100438P17.author: alessio_g

100438P17.title: A must tour
100438P17.text:
We took today the Oletrips tour to Finca El Chato. The tour itself offered more then expected not mentioning the excellent communication with the staff for the pick-up. The satff is very proffesional offering a lot of info regarding the exotic fruits (not only mango and avocado) and the tasting meal was highly appreciated.
We booked the tour including the visit to TROPS (the largest exotic fruits storage in Europe) which is a must if you visit the region.
We highly recommend this tour!
100438P17.author: marelte

100438P17.title: Great tour of the plantation with Miguel!
100438P17.text:
We had a great time during this visit to the avocado and mango plantation. Miguel was really great from start to finish: very warm, welcoming, smiling and super communicative. You can feel he likes what he does and it makes the visit even more enjoyable.

We could see lots of different fruits: bananas, passion fruit, papayas, dragon fruits and many other things. It was really interesting to find out about it.

The best part was the tasting: Miguel prepared us avocados to taste, seasoned with lemon, and it was delicious!

In addition, he gave us lots of good advice for our visits over the next
100438P17.author: J5109KYmartinw

100438P17.title: The Perfect Tropical Tour
100438P17.text:
Tropical Tour Mango & Avacado
Wonderful educational experience.Our tour gulide and driver Miguel has an enciplodia  of knowledge. A lovely lunch was laid on featuring local cheese and desert wine. We then visited Trops cooperative where we were able to purchase the local produce at very reasonable prices.
Overall a 5 star experience. Thank you Miguel
100438P17.author: seandQ3494HM

100438P17.title: Enjoyable and interesting trip
100438P17.text: Great trip. Small group. Punctual pick up in a comfortable Mercedes carrier. Miguel was an excellent guide and driver. His explanations around tropical fruit growing in Andalusia were very interesting. We visited plantations in beautiful countryside, were treated to a lovely light lunch and had the opportunity to buy local high quality produce at low prices but without any pressure. Highly recommended.
100438P17.author: Seamusschwan

100438P17.title: Great experience, informative guide
100438P17.text:
Super fun. Miguel, our guide was very knowledgeable about the area and the farm we visited. 

He was fun to talk with and prepared a fabulous picnic spread. I’m not much of an avocado eater, but the fresh ‘guacamole’ he prepared was delicious.
100438P17.author: Michael H

100438P17.title: Experience Avocado and Mango Farm
100438P17.text: We thank you for the professional family management and explanations, it has brought us a lot of new interesting. Thanks for both tour guide Miguel and Maria for the explanation at the avocado and mango farm and the picnic with fresh avocados and the last mangoes. We wish both a healthy and successful New Year. Tanya and Wolf
100438P17.author: wolfdietrichk449

100438P17.title: Really interesting experience. Small group and good price!
100438P17.text: This is a really lovely and interesting experience. We learned a lot about mangos and avocados. Cipri was a perfect guide with a personal touch when he took us through the farm.
100438P17.author: Mats N

100438P17.title: Lovely trip to the mango and avocado trees
100438P17.text: I visited Ole Farms Mango and Avocado plantation with my son. We had such a lovely time! The walk around the orchards was fun and informative – we got to pick and taste several exotic fruits and learn so much about the farm. The welcome was very personal and friendly; they really cared that we would have a great experience. The tour ended with a wonderful tasting, which was the perfect finale. A truly enjoyable experience for both adults and kids – we can’t wait to come back!
100438P17.author: Y1980QOlindae

100438P17.title: Mangofarm visit, strongly recomended
100438P17.text: The trip was great, very interesting. We learned a lot about mangos and other tropical fruits. And Miguel is a fantastic guide with great sence of humor.
100438P17.author: O2469VOmarial

17024P968.title: Learn a fun new skill and take home a perfect souvenir, small and lightweight.
17024P968.text: This was such a fun experience! My friend and I went to the workshop during our trip to Lanzarote and we made a gorgeous macrame plant holder. So easy to take back home on the plane too, because it folds up small and is lightweight. The perfect souvenir of our trip to this beautiful island! Elena is extremely knowledgeable about macrame and is a patient and fun teacher. Thoroughly recommend.
17024P968.author: Lita201

121471P39.title: Christina was an amazing...
121471P39.text: Christina was an amazing guide. I was in awe of how knowledgeable she was about thehistory of the Alhambra.
121471P39.author: Annastasia_T

121471P39.title: A little disappointed
121471P39.text: I really enjoyed it. Our guide was delightful and very knowledgeable.  The grounds are beautiful. I thought my ticket included entrance to the palace but it did not. I don’t think it was clear when booking so it was a little disappointing.
121471P39.author: 666marypath

121471P39.title: Great day at the Alhambra
121471P39.text: Our guide Enrique was great.  He was very knowledgeable and explained the details of the day very clearly.  Pick up and drop off were prompt.  The group size was perfect.  It’s a long day so plan to either bring or pick up food during some free time.  The optional nasrid palace was beautiful.  If this wasn’t added on, then you are obligated to wait for the other participants who go on this part of the tour.
121471P39.author: Cheryl_H

121471P39.title: Our visit to the Alhambra...
121471P39.text: Our visit to the Alhambra was filled with history, culture, and stories,  thanks to Enrique, our guide.  He made our pick up, drop off, and transport easy. He was knowledgeable and patient and worked to give our small group of 7 the best visit.  The Alhambra is a large place.  Our suggestion would be to offer a simple physical printed map for the participants to have as they tour.
121471P39.author: Michael_W

121471P39.title: Alhambra (small group tour)
121471P39.text: The Alhambra tour was both educational and enjoyable, with magnificent scenery. Enrique, our tour guide was very knowledgeable      and     attentive, making sure everyone had a great       experience - one of the advantages of having a small group tour (less than 6 people).
121471P39.author: Afrodita_B

121471P39.title: Great trip to Alhambra Palace
121471P39.text:
Excellent excursion to a beautiful ancient palace.
Clean air conditioned transport with very good friendly driver together with excellent, friendly knowledgeable tour guide.
121471P39.author: Llynwen_R

121471P39.title: Alhambra with Enrique!
121471P39.text: Enrique was fabulous. He was so knowledgeable and attentive and took great care of our group. I highly recommended asking for him for your day trip to the Alhambra in Granada. This is a must see in Spain !!!
121471P39.author: Sheree_M

121471P39.title: A Day Well Spent
121471P39.text: There is plenty of time to visit everything in Alhambra. Unfortunately, very little time ( 1 hour) în Granada, just enough to visit the Cathedral and its neighborhood.
121471P39.author: Valentin_L

121471P39.title: Recommended tour to the Alhambra
121471P39.text:
Easy pickup point at a central hotel and we had a comfortable journey. We were met by our guide at the Alhambra and started with a tour of the gardens. The walking around was easy, with a few steps. Our guide was very friendly and knowledgeable. The palaces were magnificent with beautiful mosaics.
A lovely trip and thoroughly recommend it. We find Viator very reliable with excellent staff and punctuality.
121471P39.author: Christine_P

121471P39.title: Tremendously fascinating experience!
121471P39.text: Our guide Enrique was truly excellent; thorough, thoughtful, and incredibly informative. Ensured that everyone was comfortable asking questions, and having further discussion about any related topic; knows the best approaches to avoid crowds, so participants are able to max out on the experience! Thank you Enrique!
121471P39.author: MaryE_S

8653P724.title: Best driver experience!
8653P724.text: Our driver Israel went above and beyond. The van was the perfect size and very clean. Israel helped with all of our luggage and was very patient as the luggage took a very long time to come out to baggage claim. Would recommend this service and will definitely use it again! Thank you!
8653P724.author: Hannah_S

8653P724.title: Guillermo excellent
8653P724.text: Guillermo was very kind and helpful. Our luggages didn’t arrive on time but he stood by and waited for us. Excellent driving and knows the area well. Thanks for patiently waiting. Thumbs up!
8653P724.author: Maria_E

2140JTCDS12.title: Brilliant
2140JTCDS12.text:

The views from the rock point of Morocco and the harbour area were excellent.
2140JTCDS12.author: petercleveleys

2140JTCDS12.title: Throughly enjoyed
2140JTCDS12.text: That it was along day but worth it crammed packed with interesting things to see and do.. although busy there was plenty of of time to explore Gibraltar town getting some duty free and good old English fish and chips. The stops are the rock were very short but the tour was well run the drivers and guides we all knowledgeable really enjoyed

TUI allowed us some free time before and after the tour to buy souvenirs and lunch.

The actual trip is outsourced to Blands Travel, who are based on Gibraltar.  Our guide was called Angel. He was very funny, knowledgeable, and passionate about the place. A tape plays an official commentary and Angel stopped the tape periodically to provide additional details which enhanced the experience. Extr

2140JTCDS12.title: Enjoying Gibraltar

A trip we took from Malaga, excellent information provided by our coordinator Zultan on the bus and then on the excursion the local Guide Matias.

2140JTCDS12.author: hectoroscaro2024

2140JTCDS12.title: Great day!
2140JTCDS12.text: Great guides safe driver saw more on the tour  than we could have on our own. Highly organised and streamlined, we were kept safe at all times through clear instructions. Great day.
2140JTCDS12.author: Vicki_S

2140JTCDS12.title: Great experience.

Thank you a perfect introduction to a beautiful city.
472902P6.author: Fionamcguigan

5624152P3.author: giulianat447

5624152P3.text: The independence of the personal audio guide gives you time to decide how long to stop at a point and you can listen to the explanation several times. The translation is not perfect but still very good, sometimes the explanations are a bit hasty and could contain more details and details, which a real guide would surely give you. However overall very positive experience at an affordable price and we will repeat with other tours.
5624152P3.author: Mana81

5624152P3.title: Highly recommend

Very easy to enter on the side of the cathedral, get the audio device and do the tour. It is a little confusing to follow the audio guide as the locations for each part of the audio tour are not marked, you have to match where you are to the map and pictures on the audio device.
5624152P3.author: stpetedoc

5624152P3.title: The cathedral is...
5624152P3.text: The cathedral is wonderful, especially the different styles of architecture and the paintings. I only have to point out that a couple times the guide would advise of an image they were referencing on the app but the image itself was not available. Other than that it was a well structured guide and very informative. Well worth booking
5624152P3.author: Jessica_G

70316P12.title: I forgot the guide's name...

70316P12.author: Yasar_Y

70316P12.title: Thoughtful, informative, beautiful.
70316P12.text:
This tour was even better than expected. I am not a fan of bullfighting and definitely did not want to attend one. But I was interested to see the arena and find out more about its cultural history and significance. 
The tour guide (I apologise it took too long to review and I forgot her name) was welcoming and very friendly. She engaged with us well, asking us questions about what we were seeing and making us think, sharing a conversation about bullfighting not just giving us information.
The arena is beautiful. The addition of the museum is great, so many artifacts and informative displays.
70316P12.author: mrsfl0ppy

70316P12.title: Must do in Malaga
70316P12.text: Must do in Malaga regardless of vies. Provides great understanding of everything. Very educational and glad I did it

This was an excellent experience!

Well worth the private guide.

Guillermo was funny, full of Interesting facts, very knowledgeable.
70316P12.author: darrene522

70316P12.title: Ole
70316P12.text: Jvan was fantastic - knowledgeable, friendly, attentive, great sense of humour. The tour is excellent, giving a thorough overview of the history and current state of bull fighting.

70316P12.title: immersion in the world of bullfighting
70316P12.text:
Our guide made the effort to speak to us in French which is rare in this city
a full tour of the arenas including behind the scenes
To do absolutely

70316P12.author: monicadP6602OI

70316P12.text:
The steward Manuel, made us the best guided tour we could have. Recommended to 100x100. You rating that the art of bullfighting carries it in the blood and lives it, that makes the guide short.
I wish you were lucky in your career

70316P12.title: Exceptional experience
70316P12.text: The guided visit to the bullring of Malagueta with Manuel was an experience that allowed us to enter the bullfighting world in a complete and enjoyable way. With a passion and knowledge that can only come from someone who has lived and breathed the bullfight, Manuel took us through the different spaces of the square, explaining the most interesting and anecdotal details of the bullfight. From the history of the square to the rituals and traditions surrounding this discipline. Manuel showed us the true essence of bullfighting. Their enthusiasm is infectious and made us feel like we were living

70316P12.text:
On August 16, I was with a friend visiting La Malagueta with Manuel, our private guide. I want to make two comments: one as a visiting tourist of the square and another as a mother.

As a tourist, although I saw all the staff very friendly and attentive, I want to make a special mention to our guide who answered with affection and patience all our doubts and lent himself very professionally to instruct us in the different aspects that make up bullfighting. 

As a mother, I intended to tell him throughout his time with us that his mother should be very proud of him, but with the maelstrom of th

221871P33.title: Learning Spanish in Malaga and exploring the city
221871P33.text:
I didn’t expect a Tuktuk ride in Málaga to change the way I saw the city, but it did.There’s something about moving quickly through narrow streets, catching glimpses of hidden plazas and sunlit facades, that makes you feel like you’re part of the rhythm of the city rather than just observing it.

Later, the Spanish cultural course gave me the depth I was craving. It wasn’t a lecture; it was interactive, alive. We explored traditions, language quirks, and everyday customs that made me feel less like a visitor and more like a participant. 

If you want to see Málaga quickly but also carry it wit
221871P33.author: 814lanai

221871P33.title: Great way to experience Malaga.
221871P33.text: After taking quick cultural crash course I managed to squeeze the tuktuk tour with a bunch of other students and travelers. I enjoyed the experience, Charley was very on top of everything, helping us with history and culture while enjoying the beautiful views of Malaga.
221871P33.author: P4735TDlukeh

17739P49.title: A definite activity while visiting Malaga
17739P49.text: I did this tour with my three 20 something year old kids. My son said this was his favorite activity we did while visiting Malaga. The bus ride was pleasant and took an hour and we got to stop to use the facilities before arriving at Caminito del Rey. Our tour guide was very good, but the highlight is the awe inspiring beauty of the gorge. We couldn't take enough pictures of everything.
17739P49.author: Diane_O

17739P49.title: A fantastic day out!
17739P49.text: The walk was exhilarating and the scenery stunning. Our guides were entertaining and knowledgeable and we felt safe and secure throughout.
17739P49.author: Adrian_H

17739P49.title: Worth the hike even in the rain
17739P49.text: Wonderful experience overall and amazing views and story. It is a long day and not for those that can not walk a lot or in variable conditions.
17739P49.author: Michelle_M

17739P49.title: Fabulous
17739P49.text:
SUPER-fantastic tour.  Bus travel from and to Malaga was flawless.  Tour guide Alex was entertaining, considerate and efficient.  We lucked up and got Rachel as a guide for the walking part of the tour.  She was excellent, taking time to encourage and answer questions, and was also very entertaining.

The natural beauty of this place is totally amazing. It is a once-in-a-lifetime experience to see something unique.  (There are other similar places in the world, however this one is probably the most accessible for normal people who are not expert mountaineers).

Overall, I'd say this tour is a
17739P49.author: Nasser_S

17739P49.title: Carminito
17739P49.text: Wonderful experience - such a beautiful place and well worth a visit. The guide Rachel was superb very knowledgable and managed the large group well. Very expensive though! Previous Viator trip cancelled a few days before that was cheaper for a smaller group 🤨
17739P49.author: Antonia_S

17739P49.title: Great excursion to Caminita del Rey.
17739P49.text: Bus left early from the outside the train station in Malaga so get there early. Everything was straightforward, bathroom stop was made 3/4 of the way there. We put on our hard hats and walked the trail. Our guide was nice taking pictures for everyone along the way. Good explanation of the history of Caminita del Rey. Highly recommend.
17739P49.author: Celeste_S

17739P49.title: Trail on the cliff
17739P49.text: The tour worked well.  Bus takes you right there, no hassle to rent a car.  The natural features, combined with the historical aspects of why a walkway on the cliff is beyond word.  Have to see it for yourself.  If you're fearful of heights, not for you.  However, the platform trail is very stable and wide.   Again, views are stunning.
17739P49.author: John_G

17739P49.title: Wonderful tour and walk
17739P49.text: Juan Carlos was our guide and he was fantastic. The tour moved at just the right pace and we felt like we were on our own, but received just the right bits of information along the way to enrich the tour and learn so many fascinating things we would not have learned if we were on our own. Perfect day!
17739P49.author: 462carad

17739P49.title: Great trip!
17739P49.text: My 14-year-old daughter loved this hike and hates hiking.  She was complaining about it for a week before the activity and once we were there, she was totally in love! (This never happens! I usually have to hear the complaints for an additional week.) The guides (bus and actual tour) were informative.  They took great photos.  And both were charismatic.  They made sure everybody was accounted for each time they talked, gave time to explore and take photos, and might have opened my kid up for future hikes!  Loved this tour. I would totally take additional tours with them if the opportunity were
17739P49.author: Aradhana_M

17739P49.title: Beautiful views on a pleasant walk
17739P49.text: Stefano is super friendly, and I am impressed by how many languages he speaks. The walk is long but easy and we moved at a manageable pace. Highly recommend.

104357P425.title: 2-hour tour of the...
104357P425.text: 2-hour tour of Malaga's must-see sights, illustrating the history of this city with a passionate and fascinating guide.
104357P425.author: Annie_M

104357P425.title: Malaga fun
104357P425.text: This experience provides great insight into the culture and history of Malaga. Robert our guide was amazing.
104357P425.author: ronda_f

104357P425.title: An excellent Malaga overview
104357P425.text: We were taken places others might not get too. Up in a hotel to a terrace balcony overlooking the city with a wonderful view. David got us into several places like a typical cafe with cheap prices, back way up to the Castillo for free. Showed us the place where Picasso was born and cost 4 euros to see many sketches and a brass figure nearby. We walked the market and had samples. Very well worth doing to give you a flavour of the city.
104357P425.author: Teresa_L

104357P425.title: Thank you David.
104357P425.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I had the opportunity to be accompanied by David and I am very satisfied with the experience. An extremely professional guide, with clear and pleasant communication. Always available, patient and very kind. Thanks to him, the visit was rewarding and very well organized. I highly recommend his services.
104357P425.author: Samir_O

124254P26.text: The experience 10/10 the guys are incredible!

124254P26.text: Wonderful mini-cruise with refreshing swimming off Malaga coast. Good bar service and well organized swimming and jumping from the catamaran. The only  improvement I could think of is to make more shade on catamaran during summer season as weather is extremely hot.
124254P26.author: Sightsee17160190265

124254P26.title: Excellent experience in Marine World with food included
124254P26.text: We loved the service and customer service, which were very friendly and professional throughout. We opted for a package that included a meal at a lovely restaurant in central Malaga, and it was a perfect choice that complemented the experience very well. No doubt we'll repeat.

124254P26.title: SUPER RECOMMENDED

63610P4.text: This is an absolute must for anyone visiting Malaga. Highlight of our trip!! Aymen was the best host, the kids and I enjoyed it thoroughly.

63610P4.text:

We wizzed up to the fortress view point. Panoramic views of Malaga. I’m so glad I didn’t climb those stairs in that heat.
63610P4.author: stephenbw2023

63610P4.author: K4213IVmandym

5624152P4.title: Great idea!?

The booking was very easy; by downloading the Ontor app, both I and my companion had immediate access and could independently explore the city of Ronda away from large tourist groups. We are thrilled and hope that these tours will continue to expand. Thank you very much!

310205P3.text:
Don’t let the entrance fool you, dropped off by our driver, we wandered off the main road and strolled down the 150 meters to the entrance gate (an iron gate with the winery’s name on the right and two winged birds and a lamp atop each stone column). 

We were greeted by the enthusiastic and gracious hostess who welcomed us to our tasting and we soon found a chilled glass of Vermut in our hand as we stood amongst the vines. The evening was neither slow nor rushed but perfectly paced as wines were presented, poured, and paired with a variety of tapas. The backdrop of the evening skyline with th

310205P3.title: lovely experience, would recommend!

The amount of wine we got to taste was a lot more than I thought we'd get for a wine tasting (which we didn't mind!).  Beautiful views from the vineyard added to the experience.  Getting to the vineyard is easily, a bus stop is directly outside, there is a little walk down a hill, but nothing unmanageable for most people.  Well worth the money in my opinion.  Lovely afternoon out.

310205P3.text:
This was one of the highlights of our trip. The property sits high on a mountainside outside Malaga with sweeping views of the Mediterranean, on a clear evening you can even make out Gibraltar and Africa in the distance. We booked the 7pm slot, which was perfect with sunset. 

Our host, Beatriz, was fantastic. We hit traffic coming out of Malaga and arrived about 15 minutes late, she didn't miss a beat and folded us right into the group. There were about 12 of us total, small enough that we ended up chatting with the other guests, which added to the experience.

She walked us through a tasting

310205P3.title: Super fun wine tasting and tapas.

310205P3.author: jeroens399

310205P3.title: Great wine in a fabulous setting.

Our host was very knowledgeable and friendly. She ensured everyone in the group (12 persons) was included in the discussions regarding which of the wines etc we liked best. 
At the end of the visit which lasted over 2 hours the host organised for a taxi to take us back to the train station. We all thoroughly enjoyed the visit and would highly recommend it.
310205P3.author: WilliamB513

This proved to be a bad move for both ourselves and another party as the Ubers both didn’t turn up and we arrived late.  Luckily the vineyard called us taxis to take us back at the end of the tasting and all went well!

El1. Expect it to be 10C cooler than Malaga, due to being inland and at 1000m of elevation.  Expect some wind as well.
2. They say the footing is rocky, rough.  Believe them.  If it's rained recently it'll be muddy and slippery in places too.

A must-do experience if you are visiting Malaga!

Fes had too many "shopping experiences" - Felt a bit pressured to buy, buy, buy at times.
Most on the tour were Spanish speakers (Guatamala & Mexico) with only 4 English speakers.
Food was good with mix of western and local.
Hotels were of varying quality and customer service within the hotels also variable - all to be expected in a developing country.
Nevertheless, Morocco must be experienced for its history, intrigue and liveliness !

The lunch was exceptional. Each course was plentiful, thoughtfully paired, and not in a gimmicky way. Standouts were the reds, which had real depth and character, but everything we tried felt considered and well-executed.

What really made the experience,

The textures of the geometric pattern, as well as the Light Processing of the interior facade, are extraordi

It is certainly a highly recommended place for those who enjoy art and culture. I'll be back without hesitation!

The exhibitions are really well curated, there is plenty of space to enjoy the art, with no crowds rushing to move you on. I went alone, whilst my family played on the beach,

He spoke good English (with a French accent) and knew where to find the most interesting birds. His high quality telescopes were great, and we saw 50+ birds including white- headed duck, marbled duck, avocet, spoonbill, flamingo, black-winged stilt, booted eagle and osprey. We had a most enjoyable day.
The reserve has well-sited bird hides, and the paths are good, but there are no facilities such as toilets.

We could not cross on the ferry back to Spain on our return date because of treacherous wind conditions that closed the port

We particularly enjoyed popping into a ham and cheese shop, and the lunch suggestions ,traditional mountain dishes were excellent.

In Pampaneira, we sampled local honey and handmade jarapas, then strolled through Bubión, learning about the Moorish heritage and village architecture.. The pace felt relaxed, with time to shop and grab a bite Michael’s recommendations for migas and local pastries were spot‑on. Highly recommended.

The bike ride did involve a fair amount of riding on gravel, but the wide  tires of his bikes made that a breeze even for this less/than-expert rider. The scenery is just lovely - olive groves, fields cleared of grain crops, white farm houses dotting the countryside.  The route is an old train line, with relatively flat terrain and numerous tunnels along the way.  There’s no better way to soak in the Spanish countryside. We highly recommend and would love to do it again.

The bikes were sturdy but light and very well maintained. We had a really relaxing and fun time and completed the ride in around 3.5 hours. Lee dropped us off at the beginning of the route and collected us at the end and took us back to Ronda. In all around a 6 hour trip.

And there is a restaurant where the trail ends with high quality food.
It was a very good day!  Do it! 😁

214764P2.author: Ruannelloyd

214764P2.text: The experience was great however when we arrived the shop front was closed with a metal grill over it, none of the phone numbers were answered! Make sure you take your driving licence because you will be driving on public roads for some of the trip,
214764P2.author: johndB1222GW

214764P2.author: Poullund_C

Highly rec

5584873P4.author: plum1963

We all had such a memorable experience and would highly recommend!
5584873P4.author: Mandymoos29

5584873P4.author: Chantal_B

Enjoyed this evening. Thank you!!
5584873P4.author: 943conniev

5638486P1.text: A fantastic couple of hours on the sea. The boat is lovely and the crew are friendly. We were offered drinks as we left the port- cava, juice or fizzy. The 2 hours flew by and we enjoyed another drink as we headed back to the port.
5638486P1.author: Katie_T

5638486P1.title: What an experience!
5638486P1.text:
What a brilliant way to spend a couple of hours on a comfortable boat with an absolutely fantastic crew. They were kind, caring, and somehow seemed to have a direct line to the dolphins’ social calendar. 
We have a great time sailing around sipping cava as the crew patiently tracked them down.
The trip didn’t ever feel rushed, we even had time for stop off and a swim. 
When we finally found the dolphins, it was pure magic. The captain creating waves for the dolphins to play in. 

A perfect mix of relaxation, laughs, and unforgettable wildlife spotting. We loved every minute of it and will defi

5638486P1.author: P5422QXmariak

Johanna picks you up and drops you off for the walks at set meeting points around Estepona and Marbella. She knows the way around the mountains and shows you places and views off the beaten tracks. This is probably the 20 th walk with her through the years and we will definetely return again.
42358P2.author: LisenNacka

42358P2.text:
In the mountains, through the (chestnut) forests, through beautiful villages, along the beautiful beach in Tarifa, the hikes with Johanna and her dog Luke take you to the most beautiful places in Andalusia. In May and October 2024 I did a total of 10 hikes. Always with different people, small group, international company, that also makes it fascinating. Many beautiful white villages seen. Often we could enjoy tapas there after the walk. 

Jimena de la Frontera, Casares, Pujerra, El Burgo, along the Guadalmina river, El Hacho mountain and the village of Gaucin, La Concha (house mountain near Ma
42358P2.author: 355odav

42358P2.text: We enjoyed the breathtaking views. There really aren't words to describe the natural beauty we saw on our hike! The high points were desert-like, but at the lower level there were lush plants to see. Make sure to bring more water than you think you need, as well as a light lunch. Hiking shoes are a must as this is an arduous hike by most people's standards.
42358P2.author: Judy_V

42358P2.text: We always go on these walks when visiting Marbella. Excellent day out and great value - local pick up, expert guide fluent in English, German and Spanish, small groups of max.8. The walks vary in difficulty from “Boots” level 1 to the most challenging at 5. I do 1 or 2 and I always enjoy the tapas lunch all together in a mountain village after 3 hours walking 😃😎. Great way to have a fun day out and make new international friends! Highly recommended!!
42358P2.author: normam940

42358P2.title: Excellent walking trips

42358P2.author: Karissa_C

42358P2.title: Great experience with the hinterland of Andalusia

42358P2.author: jeannetteb562

17739P2.text:
Even though the hotel never forgets that it has more than 600 rooms, making it a real tourist factory, the staff shows both professionalism and friendliness. This gives a total holiday feeling that never leaves.
I didn't once feel like I was being treated like a "client", except sometimes by the other...clients! Congratulations also for the efforts on behalf of PMRs and other disabled people, I benefited from the complicity in this matter of my walker , delighted to have had an excellent holiday for him.
17739P2.author: jm2xloup

17739P2.author: Terri_P

17739P2.title: Exactly what we wanted!
17739P2.text:
We were picked up at the cruise port on time and driven to Mijas (exactly what we wanted). The driver was not a tour guide, just a driver, which was fine with our group. In Mijas we were met by a tour guide who took us around the town and then we had free time to explore the area on our own. The driver then took us back to Malaga and we had additional time to explore (on our own) there before our cruise ship left the port.

There was a little issue initially in booking, but it was all resolved to our satisfaction. We'd use this company again.
17739P2.author: atwell4

This private tour was fantastic, we had Roccio as our tour guide, she made it very personalised and took us on the advertised trip and allowed time for us to go on a donkey ride around the town. Very relaxed, informative and Roccio was passionate about the culture which we loved!! 10/10 tour and friendly tour guide :
17739P2.author: Selina_O

461880P1.author: floridamad

And all this while navigating the sailboat perfectly!  Although the dolphins didn’t come out to play, it didn’t matter at all and we all enjoyed the peace of being out at sea!

Nicola messaged me the night before confirming our time and location meeting. He met me at my hotel and we started our adventure for the next 3 hours. He was personable and knowledgeable of the city, sharing some history as well. 

I got a terrific overview of this fabulous city and logged over 12,000 steps! 

Thank you Nicola! 

Steve

His knowledge of the city's history is truly impressive and I like the way he tailored the tour based on what i was interested in. If you want to really get to know Marbella, this tour is a must. By the end, I felt like a local, and I'm already planning my next visit!"

My daughter was particularly interested in the land reclamation efforts as well. Highly recommend this tour! We also had a Marbella transfer that brought us to the border crossing and met us again at the end of the tour.  Very well orchestrated!
17739P15.author: Staci_C

The reason for my overall 4-star rating is due to the transfer logistics.
